_note: Pairs were checked by eye on 2026-10-15. 'exact' means the same framing, usable in a slider. 'approximate' means the same place from a different angle: use side by side or as a sequence, not as a slider. All files are 840×458 unless stated otherwise. Local copies of every file below are in content/media/before-after/ (same filenames).

pairs.description: Street corner in front of the house: bare lawn with stakes → photomontage with a planted mineral bed (grasses, boulders).
pairs.caveat: The 'after' is a design projection, not a photo of the finished work.

pairs.description: Entrance beside a red facade: building site (boulder, pallets) → projection (grasses, black timber posts) → built (boulder, black posts, dark gravel).
